name: safari-internals.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  safari-internals.scss — Safari-only overrides for the view-project shadow
//  root, injected by the safari patch layer: disables content-visibility:auto
//  on the internal sections. WebKit does not reliably unskip skipped subtrees —
//  media and carousel slides inside them can stay blank, and lazy images in
//  skipped content never trigger — so Safari renders the sections eagerly.
//  Injected only by core/safari; other platforms keep the optimization.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Mirrors the sections that carry `content-visibility: auto` in
// internals/_internal.scss — Safari gets fully-rendered subtrees instead.
.internal {
  &-main,
  &-description,
  &-extra,
  &-footer {
    content-visibility: visible;
  }
}
